title: Chaucer's Works, Volume 4 — The Canterbury Tales
summary: "Chaucer's Works, Volume 4 — The Canterbury Tales" by Geoffrey Chaucer is a collection of stories written chiefly from 1387 to 1400. Chaucer completed fewer than a quarter of these projected tales before his death.
